sentences.text: Health visitor Rachel Moore confirmed the session is Noah's four-month check.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that Noah is on formula, five ounces every three to four hours.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she stopped breastfeeding at six weeks.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah has six or seven wet nappies a day.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah sleeps in a Moses basket in her room.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Noah does a five-hour stretch from about 11:00 and is up at 4:00.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she is sleeping since Sunday.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated that what is discussed stays between the health visitor and the GP unless the health visitor is worried about a child's safety.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that her daughter Isla said Uncle Ryan touched her private parts (front bottom) when he babysits.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that Isla said Ryan told her it is a secret and not to tell mummy.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Isla said this on Sunday night while she was in the bath.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported Ryan is Liam's brother and has been babysitting on Fridays since September.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported her sister Kelly said Ryan was in trouble years ago with the police, but Kelly does not know what it was and heard it from someone at her work.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she must share the disclosure with children's social care (Harbridge MASH) today.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised that Ryan must not babysit or have any time alone with Isla or Noah until the matter is looked into.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised the mother not to confront Ryan herself.
Health visitor Rachel Moore advised the mother to ask Liam to wait before going to Ryan's house.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported she is managing financially with Liam's warehouse wages, her Co-op money, and child benefit.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will ring the mother by 4:00 PM to tell her what Harbridge MASH said.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will ring the mother to advise that Ryan is not coming near the children.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will write to Dr Kaur today.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will see the mother and Noah next Wednesday, the second of December.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she will let Dr Kaur know so she can see the mother.
